doc.title: Aebersold Jamey — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Kimery thanks Aebersold and the NEA, and they close the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And more to come. Thank you.
You’ve got a lot more to come.

Well, on behalf of the Smithsonian Institute, myself, Ken Kimery... This has been really a treat for me to be able to sit here and spend the better part of an afternoon with you. We’ve had moments in the past, but it’s always been kind of running, because business was going on. But to be able to sit down with you and have this wonderful conversation... Of course,

the National Endowment For the Arts, because they not only have been critical in naming you an NEA Jazz Master, but they’ve also been critical in making sure these voices are documented before that moment no longer is possible. Thank you for spending time with me.
I know you’re a busy man, and it’s been hopefully the beginning of many more conversations.
